code.description: 8-digit code from the reset email (spaces allowed)

tempToken.description: Temporary token from login response when 2FA required

asset.description: Cryptocurrency asset symbol; must match an active asset with asset_type crypto.

toEmail.description: Registered user email of the recipient (case-insensitive).

asset.description: Cryptocurrency asset symbol. Must match an active asset with asset_type crypto; fiat symbols are rejected.

amount.description: Strictly positive amount (must be greater than zero); max 1,000,000,000.

initialStatus.description: Initial order status for testing (no counterparty). Default: open

paymentMethodType.description: How the deposit was funded when not using a saved method. When omitted, defaults to card. Ignored when paymentMethodId is set (type is taken from the saved payment method).
